subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should omitted cron delivery inherit a configured global recipient, continue using the preserved initiating-session route, or become silent by default?
rationale: These choices have materially different confidentiality, compatibility, and usability consequences, and current related work reflects conflicting directions.

options.title: Configured recipient inheritance
options.body: Add a cron-level destination below explicit job delivery and above the current implicit initiating route.

options.title: Keep initiating-session route
options.body: Retain current semantics and strengthen route preservation and diagnostics without adding another config key.

options.title: Silent unless explicit
options.body: Make omitted delivery non-announcing and require each job to opt into a recipient.

recommendation.title: Configured recipient inheritance
recommendation.body: Add a cron-level destination below explicit job delivery and above the current implicit initiating route.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history covers the central delivery-default, config, runtime, and documentation surfaces needed to resolve this contract.
